lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The engine hums a low and steady beat
With nothing but the asphalt at our feet
We left the city skyline far behind
With nothing but the open road in mind
[chorus]
We're living for the open road brothers
One life for us and not for the others
No ties to hold us as we roam tonight
Chasing down the morning golden light
[verse]
The single life is calling out our names
We're tired of all the little dating games
Tonight we celebrate the freedom here
With nothing but the miles to hold us near
[chorus]
We're living for the open road brothers
One life for us and not for the others
No ties to hold us as we roam tonight
Chasing down the morning golden light
[bridge]
Windows down and music playing loud
Far away from every busy crowd
Just us and the horizon in our view
Starting over fresh and born anew
[chorus]
We're living for the open road brothers
One life for us and not for the others
No ties to hold us as we roam tonight
Chasing down the morning golden light
[outro]
